fields.event_id: stable source event or transition id
fields.event_time: actual occurrence time; never ingestion time
fields.available_at: time the system could first know the event
fields.range_end_time: box end when recorded; null if still open or unknown
fields.signal_id: candidate or signal identity when available
fields.reason: source transition or exit reason when available

missing_values: remain null; never inferred from candles
